request object is signed with this key chain, so it stays the one
`clientId` was derived from when the tenant's default access key chain
changes in between.

walletNonce.description:
Cryptographic random nonce with which the wallet names the session instead of its ID.
Presentations use it in request_uri, response_uri and state (OID4VP Section 13.3:
request-id separate from the transaction-id); issuance offers in the credential_offer_uri
and as issuer_state. Issuance sessions created before 10.0 have their ID as walletNonce.

Cryptographic random code generated after successful VP Token processing.
Per OID4VP spec Section 13.3, included in redirect_uri so only the legitimate
frontend (which receives the redirect) can confirm the session completed.

errorReason.description:
Error reason if the session failed.
Stores the error message when status is 'failed'.

failureCode.description:
Machine-readable failure code when status is 'failed' (e.g.
`trust_chain_not_trusted`). Stable across credential and trust-list
formats; consumers branch on this rather than parsing {@link errorReason}.

cancelReason.description:
Reason the operator gave when cancelling the session (status
`cancelled`). Null when none was given or for sessions cancelled before
the reason was stored; the session log keeps it as well.

txCodeFailedAttempts.description:
Number of failed tx_code (transaction code) validation attempts.
Used to enforce brute-force protection in the pre-authorized code flow.
Reset implicitly when the session is consumed successfully.

consumed.description:
Flag indicating whether the session offer has been consumed.
Prevents replay attacks by ensuring each offer can only be used once.
For OID4VCI: set after successful token exchange.
For OID4VP: set after successful response validation.

consumedAt.description:
Timestamp of the first consumption event for the session offer.
For OID4VCI this can be URI resolution or later flow completion.
Null if no consumption event has happened yet.

walletProviderTrustLists.description:
Shared wallet provider trust lists for key attestations at the credential endpoint
and default wallet-attestation trust at managed authorization servers.
Each entry MUST include `verifierKey`, `verifierKeyPem` or `verifierX509Der`.

walletAttestationStatusCheckMode.description: Default status check mode for presented wallet attestations at managed authorization servers. strict rejects when the status list cannot be fetched or read; best_effort (used when unset) accepts when the list cannot be fetched but rejects an unreadable list or an index outside it; disabled skips the status check. A revoked or suspended attestation is rejected unless the check is disabled.

signingKeyId.description: Key ID for signing access tokens. If unset, the default signing key is used.

authorizationServers.description: Dedicated managed authorization servers hosted by this issuer. At least one entry is required.

federation.description:
Optional OpenID Federation configuration used for trust evaluation.
When omitted, trust checks rely on existing LoTE trust-list behavior.

registrationCertificate.description:
Optional registration certificate configuration for issuer metadata (`issuer_info`).
Supports importing an existing JWT or generating one via registrar.

registrationCertificateCache.description: Server-managed cache for generated issuer registration certificates.

notificationEndpointEnabled.description: Whether the OID4VCI notification endpoint is exposed for this issuance configuration.

credentialResponseEncryption.description: Whether `credential_response_encryption` should be advertised in the credential issuer metadata.

credentialRequestEncryption.description: Whether `credential_request_encryption` should be advertised in the credential issuer metadata.

txCodeMaxAttempts.description: Maximum failed tx_code attempts before the pre-authorized code is invalidated. Defaults to 5.

offerLifetimeSeconds.description: Default lifetime of credential offers in seconds. Can be overridden per offer request. Unset: offers do not expire.

batchSize.description:
Value to determine the amount of credentials that are issued in a batch.
Default is 1.

dPopRequired.description: Indicates whether DPoP is required for the issuance process. Default value is true.

walletAttestationRequired.description:
Default wallet attestation requirement for managed authorization servers.
When enabled, wallets must provide OAuth-Client-Attestation headers.
Default value is false.

schemaURIs.description: Schemas per attestation format. When omitted, the schema of `credentialConfigId` is used.

credentialConfigId.description: Credential configuration whose schema EUDIPLO builds and uploads; `uri` and `meta` are not needed.

format.description: Attestation format of the schema, for example `dc+sd-jwt` or `mso_mdoc`. Required with `uri`; with `credentialConfigId`, the format of the configuration takes precedence.

uri.description: URL of a schema document that EUDIPLO downloads and uploads to the registrar. Requires `format` and `meta`.

meta.description: Format-specific schema metadata, for example `{ "vct": "urn:example:vct" }` for `dc+sd-jwt`. Required with `uri`.

trustedAuthorities.description: Trusted authorities for issuers of this attestation. Required when publishing: at least one entry must provide an X.509 certificate (`trustListId`, an `x509` entry or a `verificationMethod` whose `x509Certificate` is a single certificate).

trustListId.description: Trust list of the tenant. EUDIPLO publishes it as `etsi_tl` authority with its URL and the active certificate of its key chain (the first one of a chain); the other fields are not needed.

frameworkType.description: Trust framework of an external authority. `x509` takes a root certificate in `value` and no `verificationMethod`.

value.description: Authority value, for example the trust list URL for `etsi_tl`, or for `x509` one root certificate in PEM or base64 DER. Publishing rejects an `x509` value that holds more than one certificate, such as a chain.

verificationMethod.description: Verification material of an external authority, for example a JWK, as object or JSON string. Required, except for `x509` (must be omitted) and for a `value` that is a trust list URL of this tenant (EUDIPLO adds the certificate).

id.description: Schema ID (attestation identifier URI). `publish` passes it to the registrar when set; `publish-version` requires the ID of the existing schema. With `credentialConfigId` and no `rulebookURI`, `publish` only links that credential configuration to this ID and uploads nothing.

name.description: Human-readable name. Required when publishing; not needed for a link-only request.

rulebookURI.description: URL of the attestation rulebook, which EUDIPLO downloads and uploads to the registrar. Required when publishing.

category.description: Registrar category of the schema metadata, one of the predefined values of `GET /api/schema-metadata/vocabularies`. EUDIPLO sets it at the registrar after publishing; it is not stored in the credential configuration.

tags.description: Registrar tags of the schema metadata, predefined values of `GET /api/schema-metadata/vocabularies`. EUDIPLO sets them at the registrar after publishing; they are not stored in the credential configuration.

code.description: Stable machine-readable value to submit in schema metadata category/tags fields.

replacedBy.description: Replacement code when status is deprecated.

version.description: Vocabulary publication version for cache invalidation.

categories.description: Allowed category values that can be used when updating schema metadata category.

tags.description: Allowed tag values that can be used when updating schema metadata tags.

credentialOfferUrl.description: URL where the user can receive a credential offer from this issuer.

description.description: Human-readable description to help users choose the right issuer.

tags.description: Predefined tags for filtering and search

displayName.description: Optional human-readable schema name for UI display and search

issuerOffers.description: Issuer offer entries shown to users, each with credential-offer URL and description

deprecated.description: Whether to mark this version as deprecated

supersededByVersion.description: The version that supersedes this one

transaction_id.description: The transaction identifier previously returned by the Credential Endpoint

crossDeviceUri.description: URI for cross-device flows (no redirect after completion)

claims.description: Claims to include in the credential. The structure should match the credential configuration's expected claims.

status.description: The new status of the transaction

error.description: Optional error message explaining why the issuance failed

kty.description: The key type, which is always 'EC' for Elliptic Curve keys.

crv.description: The algorithm intended for use with the key, such as 'ES256'.

x.description: The x coordinate of the EC public key.

y.description: The y coordinate of the EC public key.

keys.description: An array of EC public keys in JWK format.

response.description:
The response string containing the authorization details (JWE-encrypted VP token).
Required for success responses, absent for error responses.

sendResponse.description: When set to true, the authorization response will be sent to the client.

error_uri.description: URI with additional information about the error.

state.description: State value from the authorization request (for correlation).

request_uri.description: The request URI for the Pushed Authorization Request.

expires_in.description: The expiration time for the request URI in seconds.

interaction_types_supported.description: Comma-separated list of supported interaction types (for initial request)

request_uri.description: The request URI to use at the authorization endpoint

expires_in.description: The lifetime of the request URI in seconds

code.description: Authorization code received in the callback (authorization_code grant)

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI (must match the one used in PAR)

refresh_token.description: Refresh token (issued when refresh tokens are enabled)

redirect_uri.description: URI to redirect the wallet after authorization

response_uri.description:
Where the page posts the wallet's encrypted response. Ends with the
session's `walletNonce`; the session ID is not accepted there.

session.description: Session ID, for the management API and webhooks.

uri.description: Always empty: the request goes through `org_iso_mdoc`.

crossDeviceUri.description: Always empty: the request goes through `org_iso_mdoc`.

webhook.description:
Webhook configuration to receive the response.
If not provided, the configured webhook from the configuration will be used.

url.description: The URL to which the webhook will send notifications.

headerName.description: The header name used to send the API key.

includeRawTokensFor.description: List of credential IDs to include raw tokens for (for example ['sca_credential']).

transaction_data.description:
Optional transaction data to include in the OID4VP request.
If provided, this will override the transaction_data from the presentation configuration.

credential_ids.description: Credential query ids this transaction data applies to.

payload.description: Transaction details. Required for TS12 SCA transaction data.

clientIdScheme.description: Client identifier scheme for the OID4VP request. Defaults to x509_hash.

response_type.description: The type of response expected from the presentation request.

redirectUri.description:
Optional redirect URI to which the user-agent should be redirected after the presentation is completed.
You can use the `{sessionId}` placeholder in the URI, which will be replaced with the actual session ID.

expected_origin.description:
Optional expected browser origin for DC API key-binding audience.
Example: "http://localhost:8080"

skewSeconds.description:
Optional clock skew tolerance for this presentation offer, in seconds.
If provided, this overrides the presentation configuration for the created session.

reference.description:
Caller reference stored with the session, e.g. an order or case id.
Stored in plaintext and kept on anonymization: never put personal data here.

contentType.description: MIME type of the stored object

kind.description: Resource kind, as in the config bundle format

resourceId.description: Resource ID, or the singleton ID such as `issuance`

ownership.description: `file-managed` resources reject API and web client changes with 409 until they are detached.

source.description: File or bundle that provisioned the resource. Kept after detaching.

lastAppliedAt.description: Last time an import, detach or reattach changed the ownership
